subject: Request: Interim Assurance Letter covering post-SOC2 period (Nucleon Systems)
messages:
From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@nucleonsys.com>
To: rachel.kim@redwood.com
Date: 2026-12-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: Interim assurance letter to cover post-report period

Hi Rachel,

Hope you're well. We are finalizing our vendor attestation package for an upcoming board review and procurement window and need an interim assurance note from Redwood to cover the period after your SOC 2 Type II report (report period ended 2026-09-30) up to the current date.

Specifically, our auditors have asked for:
- A short interim assurance / continuity letter that confirms there have been no operating control regressions since the report end date, or that any changes are accounted for with compensating controls.
- A list of any material control changes, including dates and mitigations (e.g., KMS rotations, major config changes, new subprocessor additions).
- Evidence artifacts we can attach: KMS rotation logs, change control tickets for any infra changes in Q4, and a contact for a security signee.

Our target for submission is 2026-12-23 COB. Can Redwood provide a signed interim letter (PDF) and the three evidence items above? If you can share a draft letter first, that would help us route internally. Also let us know whether you require a PO or DocuSign envelope for signoff.

Thanks,
Sara Lewis
Sr. Security Program Manager
Nucleon Systems

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@nucleonsys.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Interim assurance letter to cover post-report period

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear ask and timeline. We're able to support this. Quick summary of next steps from our side: 

1) I attached a draft interim assurance letter for your review (redwood-interim-assurance-draft-20261220.docx). It intentionally keeps language concise and auditor-friendly; please flag any edits.

2) We will provide the following artifacts for attachment to your package: the SOC 2 Type II report (SOC2-TypeII-20260930-Redwood.pdf), a KMS rotation log extract covering 2026-10 through 2026-12 (kms-rotation-log-202610-202612.csv), and a list of change-control tickets for any infra/config changes after 2026-09-30.

3) On signature: our standard process is for one of the security leads to sign the interim letter. If you require a named executive signature or DocuSign envelope, let us know and we will route accordingly.

Timeline: we can produce a signed PDF by EOD 2026-12-22 provided there are no substantive edits to the draft. Evidence files will be shared as password-protected PDFs/CSVs via secure Drive link; we'll include a checksum and an internal explanatory index for each artifact.

Attachments:
- redwood-interim-assurance-draft-20261220.docx (draft)
- SOC2-TypeII-20260930-Redwood.pdf (report)

Action: please confirm acceptance of the draft language or send modifications by 2026-12-21 AM so we can finalize signature. Also confirm whether DocuSign is preferred.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

On Tue, 2026-12-20 at 09:12, Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@nucleonsys.com> wrote:
> Hi Rachel,
>
> Hope you're well. We are finalizing our vendor attestation package...

From: Sara Lewis <sara.lewis@nucleonsys.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-20T12:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Interim assurance letter to cover post-report period

Thanks Rachel — that timeline works for us. A few small requests on the draft: 

- Could you explicitly reference the report end date (2026-09-30) and state the interim period being covered (2026-10-01 through 2026-12-22)? Our auditors like explicit ranges.
- For KMS logs, can you include the key rotation event IDs and a statement that rotated keys did not result in data unavailability or re-encryption issues?
- For change-control tickets, we only need items classified as "high" or "critical" severity post-report; low/medium can be summarized.

Also, please include the name and title of the person who will sign (or confirm if it will be signed generically by "Redwood Security Lead"). Finally, please send the Drive link for artifacts rather than attachments in email.

If you can make those edits and share the Drive link by 2026-12-21 10:00 AM PST, we'll proceed to route internally and aim to include the interim note in our 12/23 package.

Appreciate the fast turnaround — Sara

On Tue, 2026-12-20 at 11:05, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com> wrote:

Heads-up: I'm on it. Plan:
- Finalize interim letter language to explicitly call out 2026-10-01 through 2026-12-22 and reference SOC 2 report dated 2026-09-30.
- Pull KMS rotation log with event IDs (will redact key material and deliver CSV) and a short attestation re: no data unavailability.
- Export high/critical change-ticket list from Jira (tickets + short summaries).
- I'll be the signatory as "Karthik Iyer, Director of Security & Compliance" unless Sara requests an executive sign-off.

Target delivery: draft updated by 2026-12-20 18:00 PST; final signed PDF by 2026-12-22 EOD. Will share secure Drive link and DocuSign preference in the next note.

Karthik
Director, Security & Compliance
